notes: Inspected all 12 views. Hexagonal brass body with star-cut ventilation holes, confirmed in the top view, a domed cap, hanging chain and a properly closed base in the bottom view. The 4 is for materials: the six glass panels render as flat pure black with no transmission or interior detail, so they read as holes rather than glazing.
limitations: Glass panels are flat black in the inspection render and need transmission plus an interior light.
Long suspension chain makes the lantern small in whole-object framing.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
